data.name: Rupchand
data.gender_notes: Rupchand is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rupchand is derived from the Sanskrit words 'rup' meaning form or wealth and 'chand' meaning lord or ruler. The name signifies being rich in wealth and prosperity, and also having the power and ability to rule. The name Rupchand carries the meaning “Rich in wealth and prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Rupchand usually hope their child will grow to embody rich in wealth and prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Rupchand is a name that represents spiritual wealth and material prosperity. It signifies the inner richness of an individual, as well as their ability to accumulate and manage material wealth.
data.etymology: Rupchand belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Rich in wealth and prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rupchand total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

The name also suggests a strong connection to business and entrepreneurship, as wealth creation and financial stability are highly valued within Hindu society.
data.spiritual_significance: Rupchand also signifies spiritual wealth and prosperity, as it is believed that attaining inner peace, wisdom, and happiness is more valuable than any material wealth. The name suggests the idea that one should strive to be the ruler of their own mind, thoughts, and emotions, and to use their wealth and power in a positive and generous way to benefit themselves and others.
